---
title: "Reports"
---

```text
ots> /dynamic S2 S1                      # analysis (S1 = noise record)
ots> /report title="Digitizer SN270" render=true
ots> /report 3                           # the last 3 results
ots> /report all formats=html
```

```python
report(title="Digitizer SN270", render=True)            # last result
report(session.results[-3:], formats=["pdf"], render=True)
dynamic(S2, noise=S1, report=True)
```

A report is a folder `reports/YYYY-MM-DD_hhmm_<title>/` with `report.qmd` and `figures/`
(PNG). It contains: context (free text), analysed signals (codes, sampling rate, unit,
sensitivity, source file, SHA-256, gaps), one section per result (figure, values with units,
tables, warnings, parameters), processing history, software versions, and a conclusion to
complete.

`render=true` runs `quarto render`; otherwise render it yourself:

```bash
cd reports/2026-11-17_1030_digitizer-sn270
quarto render report.qmd            # HTML and PDF
```

The PDF engine is chosen in the configuration: `[report] pdf_engine = "typst"` (default,
bundled with Quarto) or `"latex"` (TinyTeX: `quarto install tinytex`).

The template can be customized: copy `src/onthesignal/templates/report.qmd.j2` to
`templates/report.qmd.j2` in your project (logo, laboratory header...). Reports are written in
English.
